classes.name: WorkUnitLifecycleModule
classes.description: Sekai-owned deep module whose interface owns Work Unit creation and replay, state normalization, created-event ordering, admission, transitions, authorized reconciliation, and durable request deduplication ordering.

classes.name: SekaiGrpcTransportAdapter
classes.description: gRPC adapter that authenticates Work Unit callers, authorizes target-object access, maps protocol messages, and delegates durable lifecycle behavior to the Work Unit lifecycle module.

classes.name: WorkUnit
classes.description: Durable coordination record that moves through pending, running, and terminal lifecycle states while holding contention-scope reservations.

relations.name: delegates_work_unit_lifecycle_to
relations.description: The gRPC transport delegates creation replay, normalization, event ordering, admission, transitions, reconciliation, persistence, and request deduplication to the Work Unit lifecycle module.

relations.name: governs_work_unit
relations.description: The Work Unit lifecycle module governs durable creation, admission, transitions, and reconciliation for Work Units.
